name: qlrisk_price_fx_forward
title: Price a FXForward
description:
Price one FX Forward - agreement to exchange currencies at future date (qlrisk FXForward): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), base_notional* (amount), base_currency* (see the schema's list), quote_currency* (see the schema's list), forward_rate*. Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, counterparty_id, is_buy_base, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "base_notional": 1000000, "base_currency": "EUR", "quote_currency": "USD", "forward_rate": 1.1} gives NPV -14,371.24 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
